name: ParallaxDepthScene
description: Multilevel spatial composition where background, midground, and foreground planes translate at proportional depth intensities in response to pointer or scroll offsets.
a11yNotes: Automatically dampens motion on touch/small viewports and disables layer displacement when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

propsApi.name: depthMultiplier
propsApi.description: Maximum pixel translation of the foreground plane.

propsApi.name: damping
propsApi.description: Spring damping constant across depth planes.

propsApi.name: showGridLayer
propsApi.description: Toggle the deep background wireframe grid plane.
